newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian National Manitoba rail line closed.
newsitem.headline: Canadian National Manitoba rail line closed.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co's Bay Line between Thompson and Flin Flon may reopen at 1800 CST Thursday after a derailment closed it at 0630 CST Monday, a CN spokeswoman said Wednesday.
"The reopening of the line is tentatively set for, and I stress tentatively, 1800 March 13," CN spokeswoman Mary Jane Skulski told Reuters.

A propane tanker was leaking gas and forced the closure of Highway 6 about 125 km (78 miles) south of Thompson, site of a large Inco Ltd mine, Skulski and Wabowden detachment Royal Canadian Mounted Police Corporal Keith Finn said.

Ten cars in the 39-unit train derailed at 0630 CST Monday. No one was injured. The cause was still being investigated. Four cars had diesel fuel, one had propane and one carried gasoline, the remaining four were empty, the RCMP's Finn said.
Wabowden is 555 km (345 miles) northwest of Winnipeg.
